done_criteria: no savings or hit-rate numbers claimed anywhere in code, docs, or output
explicit_non_claims: No dollar savings are claimed by this experiment.
No cache hit-rate is promised for any workload.
OpenAI USD pricing is NOT included (counts and ratios only; cf. cost_ledger.rs for Anthropic USD).
The exact cache is for deterministic (temperature ~ 0) traffic only; sampling workloads must bypass it.

frozen_design.layer0: ensure_static_breakpoint(body, static_len): place one Anthropic ephemeral breakpoint at the last static message. Refuses (returns false) if any marker already exists anywhere — existing client breakpoints (Claude Code) are never moved, matching cache_safety.rs semantics. Never touches messages at/after static_len.
frozen_design.layer1: ExactCache: SHA-256 over canonical JSON {model, system, messages, max_tokens}, mirroring axiom_engine/response_cache.py fingerprint semantics (temperature excluded, deterministic-use-only documented). Capacity-capped with oldest-first eviction; hits/misses/entries/hit_rate stats.
frozen_design.layer2: parse_openai_usage(response): extract usage.prompt_tokens, usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens, usage.completion_tokens into counts + cache_hit_ratio (None when input == 0; missing fields read as 0 meaning 'not reported'). Companion to cost_ledger.rs, which covers Anthropic USD.

name: cache_stack L0+L1 (static-first breakpoint constructor + Rust exact response cache + OpenAI usage parse)
scope: Deterministic, dependency-free Rust in axiom_engine_rs/src/cache_stack.rs. Unit tests only — no network, no live models, no traffic replay.
